topic: The prostate cancer technology arc: from PSA screening to MRI-guided diagnosis to PSMA-targeted radioligand therapy, culminating in actinium-225 PSMA as the next-generation molecular payload.
goal: Create a 45–70 second Satoshi Reel explaining how prostate cancer technology evolved from measuring PSA to imaging suspicious lesions to using PSMA as a molecular address for targeted radionuclide delivery. Use primary research and current clinical-development evidence. End on actinium-225 PSMA as the investigational next technological step without claiming it has replaced standard care.
required_points: PSA became foundational but is prostate-specific rather than cancer-specific.
PROMIS/PRECISION established MRI-first and MRI-targeted biopsy as a major diagnostic shift.
PSMA enables molecular targeting of prostate cancer cells.
225Ac-PSMA is a next-generation alpha-emitter approach under clinical development.
visual_direction: Use a strong visual progression: blood test vial/PSA -> MRI prostate lesion -> fusion-targeted biopsy -> PSMA molecular targeting -> alpha-particle payload. Put Satoshi in a topic-relevant nuclear-medicine / prostate-imaging environment, seated or physically anchored, with short host appearances only.
tone: Dry, technically literate, slightly amused. Avoid generic cancer-awareness language.
publishing: Publish automatically to Instagram after a successful render; Instagram is the review surface.
